description.html: The low Buddha head is a wide, compact decoration that looks like old, weathered stone. The face is calm, with closed eyes, a gentle smile and long earlobes, while a band and a row of spiral curls run above the forehead. The gray surface with tiny pores and darker shadows looks as if the statue had stood in a temple garden for years.

Thanks to its low shape, this Buddha head sits well in the front of the terrarium and does not block the view of your animal. It fits tropical terrariums with plants and moss, where it evokes ruins in the jungle, as well as desert setups with sand and stones. Animals can climb over it and rest on top. If you need a taller, upright accent, take a look at the tall version of the Buddha head.

Place it on a flat, firm base or bury it slightly so it cannot tip over when the animal digs around it. Do not place it right next to a heat source. From time to time, take it out, rinse it with lukewarm water and clean the hollows around the eyes and curls with a soft brush, then let it dry completely before putting it back.
